messages:
ana: Heads-up: routing policy tweak incoming. Console team wants a small, optional priority hint so we can route certain traffic to P1 pools. Idea: SDKs can emit an extra header `X-Redwood-Route-Priority` alongside the existing `X-Redwood-Route`. Any concerns from SDK/ops teams?

mike: Extra header fine as opt-in. Quota/billing services need to know it won't create new quota buckets by default. We should map priority -> existing bucket labels in the attribution service.

sophie: Agree. Implementation: if `X-Redwood-Route-Priority` present, quota service adds metadata `priority:high|low` but keeps primary attribution key as route. That avoids split billing. Also add metric `routing.priority.seen` sampled 0.5%.

ana: (typo) ana: ha, fixed. ops: can we get a proxy shim to copy the priority header into internal metadata so older services that only read metadata continue to see it?

ops: Yes, we can add an edge-shim that copies `X-Redwood-Route-Priority` -> `x-internal-route-priority` and emit a log line when present. Can do canary deploy today. eng-bot: canary deploy scheduled: edge-proxy/shim v4 -> canary 2026-03-25T10:00:00Z

mike: SDK action: add optional param in py/ts/go clients `route_priority` default None. If set, SDK emits both headers (old plus priority) when `RW_ROUTE_PRIORITY_MODE=dual`. Unit tests should assert header emission and that header values are sanitized.

sophie: Console: I'll add a small adoption tile on the routing dashboard that shows percent of requests with priority header and a quota-delta preview. Also add an alert if unknown-route rate increases >2% after shim goes live.

ops: Ops note: guard header length <512 bytes and log/truncate otherwise. Some customers send big JSON in routing hints; we should avoid that for priority.

man: (typo) ana: thanks all. Timeline: shim canary today, SDK minor with opt-in next week, console tile in parallel. Evaluate adoption in 4 weeks then consider default opt-in. Closing thread unless blockers show up.
